questions.q: What is the single throughline underneath almost every lesson in this chapter?
options: Fabric uses a completely different table format from Databricks
Fabric replaces the need for PySpark entirely
Fabric is a new platform built around the exact same Delta Lake foundation the previous course established — the platform changed, the foundation didn't
Every Fabric item requires manual cluster configuration
questions.explain: Nothing about the transaction log, ACID guarantees, or the DataFrame API changed — only the surrounding platform did.

questions.q: How does a shortcut (Lesson 7) relate to Unity Catalog's external tables from the previous course?
options: It's a reimagined version of the same idea — a reference to data whose lifecycle lives elsewhere, not a copy
They are completely unrelated concepts
External tables don't exist in either platform
Shortcuts always duplicate the underlying data
questions.explain: This is one of the recurring parallels drawn throughout Chapter 1.

questions.q: In the traced NYC Taxi record example, what does the semantic model add on top of the cleaned data?
options: Row-level security only, nothing else
Nothing; semantic models don't appear in the traced example
A relationship to the zones table and a measure summarizing it, defined once
A completely new copy of the trip data
questions.explain: This directly reuses Lesson 13's relationships-and-measures concept in the full end-to-end trace.

questions.q: What does Chapter 2 (Real-Time Data Engineering) represent, relative to Chapter 1?
options: The final chapter of this course
A return to Databricks-only concepts with no Fabric-specific material
A repeat of Chapter 1's material with no new content
Where Fabric does something genuinely new, rather than just being the same ideas on a new platform
questions.explain: Eventstreams, KQL, and real streaming semantics weren't fully covered by the previous course's Structured Streaming material.

questions.q: How does Direct Lake mode fit into the traced record's journey through Fabric's items?
options: Direct Lake mode requires converting the data to CSV first
Direct Lake mode doesn't appear anywhere in the recap
Direct Lake mode only applies to Warehouse items, not the traced Lakehouse scenario
A Power BI report reads the final data fast and current, in Direct Lake mode, with no copy ever made
questions.explain: This ties Lesson 12's concept into the complete end-to-end trace closing out the chapter.
